Hi Maria — attaching the artifacts we can produce immediately. Summary of what is attached and a few clarifications below.

Attachments included:
- redwood-retention-matrix.pdf (maps data categories to retention TTLs and storage locations)
- deletion-events-sample.csv (sample of 10 deletion events; columns: tenant_id, object_type, object_id, deletion_timestamp_utc, operator, confirmation_token)
- lifecycle-policies-export.json (export of S3 lifecycle rules and internal TTL mapping)

Notes / clarifications:
- Backups & snapshots: automated snapshots are retained 30 days by default in us-west-2 for all hosted tenants; snapshot retention is distinct from object TTLs and is documented in the retention matrix. We can generate an exception report if a customer has requested longer backup retention.
- Deletion propagation: when a tenant is deleted via the tenant-service API we trigger a multi-step erasure that removes DB rows, rotates and truncates KV caches, and enqueues object deletions to the storage tier. Deletions are soft-flagged for 24h to ensure idempotency and then permanently deleted by the lifecycle worker. The sample CSV shows the final irreversible deletion events (post-compaction).
- Cross-region behavior: we do not automatically copy tenant data to EU regions unless a customer explicitly enables cross-region replication; when replication is enabled, lifecycle policies are enforced per-region and we include replication metadata in the export.
- Evidence limits: we can provide logs and deletion tokens for the events in the CSV; however, for security and tenant privacy we sanitize user identifiers and redact sensitive PII from delivered logs. If the auditor needs unredacted artifacts under an NDA, let us know and we'll follow the legal process.

Delivery plan: a shared Drive folder has been created: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-fintrust-evidence — the three attachments above are in the folder. We will also produce a slightly larger CSV sample (up to 100 rows) if the auditor needs more sampling coverage by 2026-01-15 EOD.

If you want a short walkthrough, I can join the call with Acuity on Jan 19.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
